products.name: RouteDesk
products.brief: Cedar Systems makes simple scheduling tools for field service teams. RouteDesk gives dispatchers one calendar, automated appointment reminders and instant reassignment when a technician calls out. It targets residential repair companies with 10–60 technicians, especially those replacing spreadsheets or hiring dispatch coordinators.

products.name: RenewalDesk
products.brief: Cedar Systems builds tools for independent service businesses. RenewalDesk tracks annual service-plan renewals and reminds office teams about agreements close to expiry. It is for companies that manage hundreds of recurring maintenance agreements by hand.
products.exclusion_phrases: does not currently sell recurring maintenance agreements

evidence.name: Northline Heating
evidence.body: Northline Heating is a residential heating repair company with 27 technicians. Northline Heating is hiring a dispatch coordinator. The coordinator currently updates a shared spreadsheet to route emergency jobs. Northline Heating offers on-demand repairs and does not currently sell recurring maintenance agreements.

evidence.name: Blue Harbor Maintenance
evidence.body: Blue Harbor Maintenance manages more than 400 annual HVAC maintenance agreements. The office team tracks renewal dates in a spreadsheet and calls customers when agreements expire. Blue Harbor Maintenance already uses a modern dispatch system to schedule field technicians.
